bibl.title: Signs and premonitions for Alexander's reign.
bibl.seg: Chiara Di Serio, Signs and premonitions for Alexander's reign.
bibl.note: Alexander's birth and his superhuman father. [Examines the accounts of the Macedonian king's conception, due to the union of his mother Olympias with the king / magician Nectanebo, or with a snake, or with the god Ammon.] - Prodigies surrounding Alexander's conquests. - Death omens for Alexander.
